en.headline: Hong Kong and Korean police sign MOU to fight cross-border crime
en.dek: The Hong Kong Police Force and the Korean National Police Agency signed a memorandum of understanding in Seoul on 29 July to deepen cooperation on drugs, human trafficking, cybercrime and training.
body: The Hong Kong Police Force and the Korean National Police Agency signed a memorandum of understanding in Seoul on 29 July to strengthen cooperation against cross-border crime and professional training.

Commissioner of Police Chow Yat-ming and Acting Commissioner General of the Korean National Police Agency Yoo Jae-sung signed the document. The agreement covers joint efforts against drug trafficking, human trafficking, cybercrime and money laundering, as well as intelligence exchange and capacity building.
The force said the new MOU builds on a 2015 agreement and aims to create a broader platform for law-enforcement cooperation across the Asia-Pacific region.

zh.headline: 港警與韓國警察廳簽署合作備忘錄 打擊跨境罪案
zh.dek: 香港警務處與韓國警察廳7月29日在首爾簽署合作備忘錄，加強打擊跨境罪案及專業培訓合作，涵蓋毒品、人口販運、網絡罪案及情報交流。
body: 香港警務處與韓國警察廳於7月29日在首爾簽署合作備忘錄，以深化打擊跨境罪案及專業培訓方面的合作。
文件由警務處處長周一律與韓國警察廳代理廳長劉在成簽署。備忘錄涵蓋共同打擊販毒、人口販運、網絡罪案及清洗黑錢，以及情報交流和能力建設。
警方表示，新備忘錄建基於2015年的協議，目標是為亞太區執法合作建立更廣泛平台。
